source.author: verg
source.text: praesensit, motusque excepit prima futuros, omnia tuta timens.
source.text_original: praesensit, motusque excepit prima futuros, / omnia tuta timens.
source.text_english: she foresaw it and first caught the future movements, fearing that all was safe.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: huic ego, ut ait gentilis poeta, omnia etiam tuta timeo.
reuse.text_original: huic ego, ut ait gentilis poeta, omnia etiam tuta timeo.
reuse.text_english: I, as a pagan poet says, fear everything even when it is safe.
